name: Constraint-aware LLM steering and planning system

mentions.name: Constraint-aware LLM steering and planning system
mentions.description: This project adds steering and planning to LLMs and similar models (transformers, DiT, etc.) in a way that is aware of market, physics, and other ground-truth constraints. It combines reinforcement learning with optimization (e.g., MILP) on the planning side, and a small model built with it outperforms some of the largest frontier models in adversarial games, though it is not yet realtime enough to play RTS games.
mentions.problem: Plain LLMs are the wrong mathematical object for gameplay and adversarial settings, lacking planning grounded in real-world constraints.
mentions.source_excerpt: My side project this quarter has been building a system that adds steering / planning to LLMs/WAMs/etc. (T, DiT, etc.) in a market/physics/other-ground-truth-constraints aware way.
